metadata.description: Obsidian Intelligence Layer — Copilot plugins for agent workflows over an Obsidian vault.

plugins.name: oil-vault-kit
plugins.description: Obsidian Intelligence Layer for Copilot: the oil MCP server (tiered vault search, graph traversal, mtime-guarded writes, audit trail), the oil-setup diagnosis skill, and the OIL Vault Activity canvas showing the notes the agent read and changed, with diffs and analytics. Optional local semantic search via Ollama.
